sentences.en: I wouldn't say I was a hardcore fan at this point.

sentences.en: I'm not playing hardcore free jazz, this is a lot more modern.

sentences.en: I am expecting the conclusions, as with so many things, to point toward pragmatic compromise rather than dogmatic, hardcore fundamentalism.

sentences.en: So I did that and everything was fine My GPU core only went upto about 61 C even on hardcore gaming!
